name: pinkpuma-toolbelt
description: Personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins for daily development work.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Conventional commit messages, branch names, PR descriptions, and changelog entries.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Save and resume in-progress, uncommitted work across sessions.

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: Scaffold and keep a project's documentation current, sized to the project.

plugins.name: feature-planning
plugins.description: Turn an idea into a rich feature spec and self-contained dev tickets, across a separate feature board, ticket tracker and code.

plugins.name: npm-publish
plugins.description: Audit and set up automated npm releases via GitHub Actions and Trusted Publishing (OIDC).
